turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit down quietly, no pushing. Today we do subtraction. The sum is fifty two minus twenty seven. Write it in your copy.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote 35? No, no. That is wrong. The answer is 25. Write 25 and say it, fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjoon, again 35? I told you already. 2 is small, so take one ten. 12 minus 7 is 5. Then 5 minus 2 is 3... no, listen again. 12 minus 7 is 5, then tens. Listen properly this time!
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Mina, 26 is also wrong. Don't count on fingers, it is a bad habit. Sit down, we will go ahead.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Everybody, answer is twenty five. Thumbs up who got twenty five. Okay, some hands only.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Now next sum. Forty three minus eighteen. Do it fast, I am coming to check copies.
turns.label: new_sum
